modules.name: bin-utils
modules.description: Static arm64 binaries (curl, wget, jq, bash, sendat, busybox) + CA bundle + lib/common.sh shared helpers.

modules.name: Telegram Status Bot
modules.description: Telegram bot for status, performance, SMS, IMEI, /update, /install_module, etc. (12-language UI)

modules.name: Cloudflared Tunnel
modules.description: Cloudflare Tunnel daemon for remote SSH/ADB via Zero Trust.

modules.name: Dropbear SSH
modules.description: SSH server on port 22222 with key-only auth.

modules.name: Wireless ADB Keeper
modules.description: Forces ADB on port 55555 every boot (avoids UFI conflict).

modules.name: Tailscale Control
modules.description: Tailscale daemon + bot integration, adaptive routing, exit node.

modules.name: AdGuard Home
modules.description: Network-wide DNS ad-blocker; transparent NAT redirect for hotspot clients.

modules.name: Cellular Tools
modules.description: Periodic AT-command poller, cell tower DB, IMSI-catcher anomaly detection. Powers /spectrum, /imsi_watch, /locate.

modules.name: SMS Command Channel
modules.description: Offline SMS-based backup command channel. When Telegram is unreachable, an authorised phone can SMS the device a short command (status, locate, reboot, panic, kill). Three-gate security: whitelist + secret + allowed-command list.

modules.name: Tor Bridge (VPN-aware)
modules.description: Tor 0.4.9.8 bridge node (NOT exit) — contributes anonymous bandwidth from your cellular SIM, capped to 256 KB/s. Bundled OpenSSL/libevent (~9 MB). VPN-aware routing.

modules.name: HTTPS MITM Lab
modules.description: ⚠ DANGEROUS — transparent HTTPS MITM proxy. Decrypts TLS for selected hotspot clients via custom 4.8 MB Go binary + self-signed CA. Installed but DISABLED by default. Cert-pinned apps will break.

modules.name: Embedded SIP Server [UNDER DEVELOPMENT]
modules.description: ⚠ EXPLORATORY. Static UDP/5060 SIP server (~2.4 MB Go binary). Pairs with the f50sip-app (com.f50.sip) to forward SMS-over-SIP and call signaling between the F50 and companion devices. SMS path works; end-to-end cellular-call observation across screen-off is pending and depends on ims-voice-fix to be valid.

modules.name: VPN Gateway (Tailscale-aware fork)
modules.description: F50 fork of Kr328/vpn-gateway. Routes hotspot LAN clients through tun0 (Clash/sing-box/openclash); adds a high-prio ip rule that pins Tailscale CGNAT (100.64.0.0/10) to the main table so replies from on-device services to Tailscale peers don't get misrouted into the VPN tunnel.

modules.name: IMS Voice Fix [UNDER DEVELOPMENT]
modules.description: ⚠ EXPLORATORY — root cause unconfirmed. Bind-mounts a patched com.spreadtrum.ims; replaces PhoneStateMonitor.onScreenStateChanged(0) in the SCREEN_OFF receiver with 3x nop. Hypothesis: F50's short screen timeout was tearing down cellular/VoWiFi calls. Counterexample seen on another F50 same carrier → not confirmed yet. See repo for the screen_off_timeout=infinity self-test.

modules.name: Hotspot Region (WiFi Country Code)
modules.description: Change the WiFi regulatory region/country code at runtime (default TR, selectable) via cmd wifi force-country-code — no file edits, no bootloop risk. ADB CLI + statusbot /region.

modules.name: Lite Mem (zram + debloat)
modules.description: Memory relief for the low-RAM F50: extra zstd zram swap, vm tuning, configurable debloat, and a shell-toggleable kill of the ZTE goform web panel. CLI: lite-mem status / webui off|on.

modules.name: WebView Provider (Google WebView)
modules.description: Ships Google WebView as a system app + product overlay registering it as the system WebView provider. The stock F50 has no usable WebView. ~247MB (bundled APK).
